reason: Owner-requested Roach Synth performance controls, mouse/touch gestures and native Voicesaurus voices; preserve the historical catalogue fixtures and every other instrument record.

roach-synth.description: A grounded cockroach scan with 31 playable joints, 24 animations, a body-part mixer, real movement recordings and a Low KAL16 speech voice with adjustable speed.
roach-synth.start: Turn Audio on and press Play to animate. Drag a body part at any time, scroll to zoom, choose independent animation and sound presets, or type words for the roach to say.
